memory_candidates.content: When rescuing/porting files from a gitignored deploy tree into an agent-system extension source, always re-cmp every file against the census immediately before writing (not just trust the earlier research census) -- drift between research and implementation is real and caught this way. Also check-extension-docs.sh must be run from a DEPLOYED scripts/ tree, not the agent-system source tree -- it self-detects source-tree invocation and errors with a redirect instruction, since its ../.. relative path resolution assumes a deployed .claude/scripts/ or .opencode/scripts/ location.

To verify a manifest-driven deploy without writing into .claude/**, simulate it in a scratch directory: iterate provides.scripts entries, copy each with shutil.copy2 (preserves executable mode) from the extension scripts/ source to <scratch>/<entry>, then run any --self-test entrypoint from the scratch copy to exercise deployed-path sys.path.insert resolution. This catches import/path failures a source-tree run would mask, entirely outside .claude/**.
